description: Implementation of the FunctionsGL class for managing OpenGL functions and extensions within the ANGLE project, including version detection, extension handling, and stub functions for null driver support.

classes.name: FunctionsGL
classes.description: Class responsible for loading and managing OpenGL function pointers, extensions, and versioning.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL function pointers, detects version and extensions, and sets up stub functions if needed.

methods.name: isAtLeastGL
methods.description: Checks if the current context's GL version is at least the specified version.

methods.name: isAtMostGL
methods.description: Checks if the current context's GL version is at most the specified version.

methods.name: isAtLeastGLES
methods.description: Checks if the current context's GLES version is at least the specified version.

methods.name: isAtMostGLES
methods.description: Checks if the current context's GLES version is at most the specified version.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is supported.

methods.name: hasGLExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is supported in desktop GL.

methods.name: hasGLESExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is supported in GLES.

methods.name: initializeDummyFunctionsForNULLDriver
methods.description: Sets up dummy function implementations for null driver configurations.
